about: THEME8 (2026-11-11): suggested Yes lists for main Maps 12-20, admin adds for Maps 0-11, side-map lists up to the Map 20 region, skills per map, the Sea Bass and the monster set pieces. Design only: nothing applied. Built by tools/theme8/build_suggestions_2026_11_11.py from tools/theme8/picks_2026_11_11.py. suggest = NEW to the road (no earlier main map gives it, admin adds counted), carried = given earlier. Maps 0-11: suggest/carried split the owner's Yes; adminAdd is Claude's. usage = main Maps 0-20 (owner Yes + adminAdd + suggestions).

seaBass.name: Sea Bass
seaBass.element: water (Tide); damage physical, as the other reef fish
skills: Wave 1: hits push the target 1 column; a crash deals 1 to both (the surf it hunts in)
Swarm (Fish): +1 Attack for every Fish ally (it runs in loose packs)
seaBass.why: Wave is new to the road here: the owner's Map 10 picks bring no new skill, and Coral Current is the fast-current map. Swarm (Fish) pays off the map's fish (Clownfish Scout, Reef Shark, the eels).
seaBass.flavor: The fishermen call it the wolf of the sea. It hunts the surf in loose packs and never fights the current.
seaBass.art: Pixel art, 32-bit era game sprite style, crisp hard edges, limited palette, dark 1-pixel outline, soft light from the upper left, warm muted woodland colours (moss green, bark brown, river teal, berry red) with one bright accent, cute expressive animal character with a slightly large head, clean readable silhouette, no text, no watermark, no signature. Full-body character in a small scene, centred, slight low angle: a cute silver sea bass with big bright eyes and a dark spot on its gill cover, sleek silver body with faint dark lines along its flanks, riding the white curl of a breaking wave over a reef wall, two smaller sea bass glinting in the water behind it, sunlit teal shallows background with coral heads and a pale sandy bottom, one bright coral-orange accent. Natural animal anatomy, not anthropomorphic, no hands, anatomically correct fish: one streamlined body with no limbs, two dorsal fins, a pair of pectoral fins, a pair of pelvic fins, one anal fin and a forked tail fin.
